figures.finding: Portuguese actors' union is CENA-STE, the union of performing arts, audiovisual and music workers, which organises strikes under the Labour Code; members pay dues by bank transfer or, if employed, by a 1% deduction from salary authorised to the employer. Its menu of rate tables (TABELAS) is empty.
